results.title: Sentiment in Software Engineering - Pure
results.content: In this thesis, we study expressions of sen-timent and emotions, and specifically, we study three aspects of sentiment and emotions in software engineering: Theory, Tools, and Practice. Through studying the tools used to classify sentiment and emotions in software engineering texts, we find small differences in performance scores between contemporary machine-learning tools and recently released deep-learning tools. In Proceedings of the 1st International Work-shop on Software Engineering Research & Practices for the Internet of Things, 254 STUDIES SELECTED FOR THE LITERATURE REVIEW SERP4IoT@ICSE 2019, Montreal, QC, Canada, May 27, 2019. Nathan’s research interest is human aspects of software engineering, and in his doctoral thesis, he studied how the expression of emotions and sentiment by software engineers affects software development.
